title: Potatoism Spiral Reader Map
purpose: Order the public Philosophy journey as a spiral of increasingly capable questions. This file owns reader sequence, not doctrine.
pedagogical_law: Every new concept should answer a problem generated by an earlier concept, and each turn should return to the same center with more relation, responsibility and capacity.

turns.title: Turn I · Seed
turns.summary: See what is here before building a philosophy around it.

stations.title: Potato
stations.question: What is actually here before the label?

stations.title: Mud / burden
stations.question: How much of the weight is the condition, and how much is the way it is being carried?

stations.title: Emotion
stations.question: Can emotion be observed as information without becoming either enemy or oracle?

stations.title: Empty vessel
stations.question: What must be released to create room for something living rather than merely make the self smaller?

stations.title: Stillness
stations.question: What becomes visible when the noise is no longer doing all the talking?

stations.title: Chew
stations.question: Have you actually encountered the idea, or only acquired its name?

turns.title: Turn II · Root
turns.summary: Grow without confusing effort with force.

stations.title: Essential simplicity
stations.question: What can be removed without destroying what matters?

stations.title: Light / orientation
stations.question: Toward what should growth actually be oriented?

stations.title: Efficiency
stations.question: Once direction is known, which motion no longer serves it?

stations.title: Wu wei / natural growth
stations.question: What work belongs to growth, and what force comes from refusing to understand the conditions?

stations.title: Soil
stations.question: Which conditions, histories and relations change what can grow here?

stations.title: Dormancy
stations.question: Is hiddenness protecting development, or preventing emergence?

stations.title: Root / shoot
stations.question: Can different parts move in different directions while serving one larger life?

stations.title: Eye / possible futures
stations.question: Which viable possibility should receive resources, and which may remain only possible?

turns.title: Turn III · Door
turns.summary: Move from isolated things to thresholds, relations and frames.

stations.title: Door
stations.question: What changes the state or the set of possibilities available next?

stations.title: Boundary
stations.question: What does this boundary protect, permit, exclude or imprison?

stations.title: Relation
stations.question: What does the thing depend on, change, receive, carry and enable?

stations.title: Functional identity
stations.question: If the title were translated into a verb, what would it actually do?

stations.title: Observer / window
stations.question: From which side of the Door is the world being seen?

stations.title: Filter and Potato Truth
stations.question: Can a useful interpretation survive when the Potato vocabulary is removed?

stations.title: Floor / Plane
stations.question: What frame contains the problem, and what assumptions have become invisible because they are underneath everything?

stations.title: Center
stations.question: Is this a source center, local center, meeting center, or merely the center of attention?

turns.title: Turn IV · Spiral
turns.summary: Return to damage, time and recurrence with more tools than before.

stations.title: Mud again
stations.question: Now that you can see relations and frames, what is the mud actually doing?

stations.title: Compost
stations.question: What can change function without pretending the past never happened?

stations.title: Forge
stations.question: What capability still exists when the pressure is gone?

stations.title: Suffering is not proof
stations.question: What downstream learning, repair or nourishment justifies calling ordeal transformative?

stations.title: Ring / Spiral
stations.question: What is different this time besides elapsed time?

stations.title: Ladder / Mountain / Tree
stations.question: Is this process thresholded, gradual, branching, or something else?

stations.title: House / many rooms
stations.question: Can one whole protect differentiated parts without flattening them?

stations.title: Ancient Future
stations.question: How can something return faithfully without rebuilding an untouched past?

stations.title: Breaking / many
stations.question: When does fracture reveal regenerative multiplicity rather than simple destruction?

turns.title: Turn V · Fruit
turns.summary: Make knowledge, capability and power answerable to consequence.

stations.title: Storage / release
stations.question: What is stored here, what releases it, and who receives it?

stations.title: Knowledge → Life or Strife
stations.question: What is this information being made to do?

stations.title: Reciprocal transformation
stations.question: What does this method turn the user, target and relation into?

stations.title: Potato Truth
stations.question: Can truth remain accurate, source-visible and repair-capable without cruelty becoming its badge?

stations.title: Capability → responsibility
stations.question: What additional restraint follows from claiming greater power, knowledge or authority?

stations.title: Quiet Triumph
stations.question: Can influence be measured by nourishment, persistence and service rather than spectacle?

stations.title: Fruit
stations.question: What actually happened downstream?

turns.title: Turn VI · Garden
turns.summary: Teach, cultivate and transmit without making yourself permanently necessary.

stations.title: Garden / shadow Farm
stations.question: Does this system increase autonomous capacity, or preserve dependency for extraction?

stations.title: Gardener
stations.question: Can conditions be improved without pulling the organism upward by force?

stations.title: The whole job
stations.question: Which invisible infrastructures make the visible outcome possible?

stations.title: Gardener's Paradox
stations.question: Can successful cultivation reduce unnecessary dependence on the cultivator?

stations.title: Seed-maker
stations.question: Can the lesson reproduce without copying the entire personality or mythology that produced it?

stations.title: Reader as Soil
stations.question: How much of meaning belongs to source, reader, context and the relation among them?

stations.title: Curiosity before allegiance
stations.question: Can the idea be examined seriously before the reader joins the identity around it?

stations.title: Anti-bloat return
stations.question: Can all this complexity return to something simple enough to use?

stations.title: Begin again
stations.question: What does ‘Be simple. Grow toward light.’ mean now?

reader_handoff: The final reader should not be asked to become a follower. The reader should leave more capable of noticing conditions, identifying thresholds, testing relations, cultivating autonomy, evaluating fruit and making a transferable Seed from what was learned.
epistemic_note: This map combines Great Book material, conversation recovery, project canon, comparative mirrors, biological correction and archive synthesis. It does not flatten those classes into one kind of evidence.
